subject: SIG prefill decision tree and clarifying questions for VitalBridge
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
To: Emily Chen <emily@vitalbridge.io>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Sep 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG prefill decision tree and clarifying questions for VitalBridge

Hi Emily — great to chat earlier. Quick recap from our discovery and the follow-ups we discussed so we can pick the right questionnaire path and owners. TL;DR: you indicated a preference for CAIQ if acceptable; VitalBridge requires HIPAA (BAA), and you have EU + US residency needs.

Recap / current state you shared:
- SOC 2: you indicated roadmap but not yet Type II; looking to start SOC work in Q4 2028 (no Type II currently).
- Privacy/regulatory: GDPR applies (EU data subjects); VitalBridge processes PHI and requires HIPAA protections and a BAA.
- Preferred questionnaire: you said CAIQ is already partly completed on your side and would be fastest.

Clarifying questions we need to finalize the intake and evidence request (please confirm):
1) Questionnaire choice: Confirm we should prioritize CAIQ + supporting evidence vs Redwood's SIG-prefill output. If CAIQ, will you share the CAIQ export and any mapped evidence?
2) Evidence owners: Who at VitalBridge will own evidence delivery (name + email for SOC, InfoSec, and Legal/Privacy)?
3) Data residency: Confirm EU regions required (e.g., eu-west-1) and whether any data must remain on-prem or behind a customer-managed VPC.
4) Retention & logging: Does VitalBridge require tokens not be logged at all, or acceptable to retain logs for X days? Any special redaction/PII policies?
5) Subprocessors: Do you have an up-to-date subprocessors list we should map against our controls?
6) Timeline constraints: Any hard procurement dates or contract cutovers we should target?

What we propose for next steps if CAIQ is preferred:
- You share CAIQ export + any evidence links by EOD Sep 8. (Attachment: I’ve included our SIG prefill template to speed mapping.)
- Jordan will map CAIQ answers to Redwood’s SIG fields and flag evidence gaps (ETA 3 business days after receipt).
- Kimberly will draft a BAA template for review and loop Legal if needed.
- If there are HIPAA-specific evidence items (pen tests, encryption at rest keys, access logs), we’ll call those out explicitly.

Attachments: redwood_sig_prefill_template.xlsx (spreadsheet template), call_recording_20280904.mp3 (meeting recording).

Would you confirm the CAIQ route and provide the names for evidence owners? Happy to jump on a 20-min follow-up if that’s easier — I’m available Sep 7 between 10–12 PT.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
hannah@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0194

From: Emily Chen <emily@vitalbridge.io>

Date: Tue, 4 Sep 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG prefill decision tree and clarifying questions for VitalBridge

Hi Hannah — thanks for the clear recap and the template. Confirming answers inline: 

1) Questionnaire choice: We’d like to go CAIQ-first. We already have a CAIQ export (internal security team started this earlier this year) and can share the export + supporting evidence bundle.
2) Evidence owners:
   - InfoSec owner: Marcus Lee (marcus.lee@vitalbridge.io)
   - Legal/Privacy: Diane Park (diane.park@vitalbridge.io)
   - Procurement: procurement@vitalbridge.io (for contract/BAA)
3) Data residency: Primary deployment needs in us-west-2 and eu-west-1. No on-prem requirement, but EU data must remain in EU regions for EU clients.
4) Retention & logging: We require that any raw request payloads containing PHI not be persisted beyond 30 days. We can accept ephemeral caching for performance if logs are redacted.
5) Subprocessors: We have a subprocessors register — I’ll include the most recent export with the CAIQ bundle.
6) Timeline: Procurement would like a BAA and evidence packet by Sep 20 to meet their internal vendor review window. No hard contract signature date yet.

I’ll upload the CAIQ export and evidence zip to a temporary S3 link by EOD Sep 6 and share here. Happy to do the 20-min follow-up on Sep 7 at 10:30 PT if that works for you.

Emily
Emily Chen
VP, Product & Partnerships, VitalBridge, Inc.
emily@vitalbridge.io | +1 (206) 555-0142
